sample_unit: LLM-generated patient education materials (4 models x 4 dental scenarios)

links.outcome: PEMAT understandability and actionability of LLM-generated dental patient education materials against 70% threshold
links.effect: ChatGPT-4.0 exceeded the 70% PEMAT understandability threshold in 3 of 4 scenarios; Claude 3.5 Sonnet did so in 2 scenarios and did not consistently meet 70% for actionability.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.0 excelled in understandability, surpassing the PEMAT threshold of 70% in three of the four scenarios.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLMs generating patient education materials for dental scenarios, scored offline by dental professionals using standard readability and PEMAT metrics, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
